content:
carmen_marketing: Heads-up 1: iterative battlecard + webinar intro needed. Focus: competitive claims vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors; angle is 'serving economics + reliability'. Deliverables: 1) SDR one-pager (soundbites + quick objection handlers), 2) short benchmark blurb for slide, 3) routing rules for webinar leads. Deadline: Fri EOD.

vik_research: Posting sanitized bench highlights (internal):

```text
Workload: multi-turn assistant, avg 360 tokens
Testbed: eu-west-1, A100-class equiv, steady 75% util, 800 concurrent sessions
Redwood (prod-opt): p50 36ms, p95 105ms, cost-per-convo $0.016
CloudAPI (managed): p50 82ms, p95 225ms, cost-per-convo $0.041
Self-host baseline: p50 30ms, p95 310ms under burst, cost-per-convo $0.028
```

carmen_marketing: Good. Use relative phrasing on slides: "~2x lower p95 vs CloudAPI in our tests" and mark as internal until review. Add a 1-line testbed note: region + node class + synthetic traffic.

drew_sales: For SDR one-pager: I want 3 hooks and 3 procurement rebuttals. Hooks: 1) "Worried about tail latency?" 2) "Need predictable unit economics?" 3) "Dont want to manage all the infra?" Rebuttals: short lines for "we have infra", "data sensitivity", "pricing".

molly_content: I'll draft the one-pager and a 10-word hero for the webinar landing. Candidate hero: "Predictable inference: lower tail latency, clearer unit costs, built-in fallbacks." Thoughts?

vik_research: Add methodology caveat: "Quantized model profile; steady-state GPU util; synthetic session mix. Results depend on model and traffic patterns."

carmen_marketing: Routing rules for webinar leads: if "SLA interest" or "enterprise" -> enterprise-sales; if "trial" or "try API" -> trial SDR; if "private deployment" or "compliance" -> solutions eng. Include a poll on pain: latency/cost/compliance to help route.

drew_sales: I'll add a tiny ROI example for 1M conv/mo showing per-convo differences across hosted on-demand, dedicated reserved, and private. Will post numbers by 3pm.

ops_bot: bench artifacts uploaded (internal link withheld)

molly_content: Will prepare copy and SDR one-pager draft by 2pm and attach here. Carmen, I'll give two hero variants for A/B.

carmen_marketing: Thanks. Final checklist: label anything "internal" until legal signs off, use conservative relative language, owners: Molly (copy + one-pager), Vik (bench + caveat), Drew (SDR hooks + ROI), Carmen (assembly + deck). Dry-run Fri 9am PT.

(END)
